note: Draft contract templates for Dealmaker. They are not legal advice and must be reviewed by a qualified lawyer in the UAE before they are activated. Seed them with is_active = false.

templates.name: Emcee for an event
templates.description: Master of ceremonies for weddings, galas and corporate evenings.

clauses.title: Parties and services
clauses.body: {artist} (the talent) will provide the following services to {client} (the client): master of ceremonies, running the programme, introductions and audience engagement. The service is booked as {service} on {date} at {time}, at {venue}.

clauses.title: Fee, deposit and escrow
clauses.body: The total fee for {service} is {total} including 5% VAT of {vat}. The client pays the deposit shown in the booking into Dealmaker escrow, and any remaining balance is due seven days before {date}. Funds are released to {artist} after the event, once the dispute window has passed.

clauses.title: Arrival, timing and delivery
clauses.body: {artist} arrives and is ready at the agreed time. The client confirms access to the venue, the schedule and a contact person on site. Delays caused by the venue or the client extend the booked time at the same rate.

clauses.title: Programme and run of show
clauses.body: The client shares the run of show at least three days before {date}. {artist} may adapt wording and pacing for the audience while keeping the agreed programme.

clauses.title: Cancellation and refunds
clauses.body: If {client} cancels 14 or more days before {date}, the refund is 100%. Between 7 and 13 days the refund is 50%. Under 7 days there is no refund. If {artist} cancels, {client} receives a 100% refund.

clauses.title: Recording and content rights
clauses.body: Photos or recordings of the performance may be made by {client} for private and promotional use only. Commercial rebroadcast or resale needs the written agreement of {artist}.

clauses.title: Law, conduct and content
clauses.body: Both parties follow the laws of the United Arab Emirates and the rules of the venue at {venue}. Content, language and dress must respect local cultural norms and licensing requirements.

templates.rider: Wireless microphone with a backup, a table or podium, water, and a printed run of show.
